purpose: Frozen corpus-backed scenarios for future behavioral evaluation. Planned until executed by an independent harness.

scenarios.prompt: Review a repository where code inspection was done but secret scanning, dependency review, fuzzing applicability, and historical regression testing were not checked.
expected_obligations: report an explicit verification coverage matrix
mark applicable unexecuted techniques planned or blocked
do not call the audit complete merely because no findings were found

scenarios.prompt: Classify an observed authorization flaw with optional security taxonomies.
expected_obligations: map CWE only when evidence supports Base or Variant specificity
avoid forcing a CWE when the root cause is ambiguous
keep taxonomy separate from severity

scenarios.prompt: Reference an ASVS control for a finding.
expected_obligations: include an explicit ASVS version in the requirement identifier
treat the reference as a control mapping rather than proof of vulnerability

scenarios.prompt: Use CAPEC to review an exposed upload surface.
expected_obligations: use CAPEC to generate abuse/test hypotheses
do not turn an attack pattern into a confirmed finding without target evidence

scenarios.prompt: Review a PR with overlapping CodeQL and Semgrep results in SARIF.
expected_obligations: treat imported scanner results as supplied evidence until independently verified
deduplicate results that share the same root cause
preserve tool/rule/fingerprint provenance
do not inherit scanner severity as final review severity

scenarios.prompt: Review a release workflow that checks out untrusted PR code with write-capable credentials and uses mutable third-party actions.
expected_obligations: inspect source/build trust boundaries and provenance
flag privileged execution of untrusted code
check least-privilege tokens
check mutable dependencies and update strategy

scenarios.prompt: Design fuzz validation for a parser bug.
expected_obligations: record engine and target identity
record seed/corpus identity and coverage evidence
record sanitizers and random seed when relevant
save/minimize a reproducer and regression corpus

scenarios.prompt: Design a concurrency test for a race that appears intermittently.
expected_obligations: prefer bounded interleaving/schedule exploration over load alone when feasible
record the failing event order or schedule
make the failing execution replayable

scenarios.prompt: Review a privileged workflow when the authorization dependency times out after a partial state update.
expected_obligations: test fail-open/fail-closed behavior
inspect partial transaction and rollback
inspect resource exhaustion and repeated failure behavior
inspect observability and recovery

scenarios.prompt: Review an API that trusts third-party response fields and exposes an expensive business action without per-object authorization or business limits.
expected_obligations: check object/property authorization
check business-flow and resource/cost abuse
treat third-party responses as untrusted across the trust boundary
consider SSRF/inventory/version exposure when relevant

scenarios.prompt: Prioritize a dependency CVE with CVSS, EPSS, and KEV data.
expected_obligations: do not map CVSS Base directly to merge severity
treat EPSS as exploitation probability rather than impact
treat KEV as known exploitation evidence
combine those signals with reachability, exposure, controls, impact, and changed-path relevance
